svg.title: Lane closure plan (temporary traffic control, fictional)

g.text: A lane closure is mostly road, not work: 2,550 ft of it to work on 500 ft.
The buffer is drawn empty on purpose - it is the room a driver needs to stop.
The plan is not to scale; the strip beside it is, along its length only.
Speeds, widths and lengths are fictional; the road authority decides them.
THE EMPTY PART IS THE DESIGN
TAPER LENGTH FOR A 12 FT OFFSET
350 ft apart on an urban arterial
not over the speed in feet: 45 ft
it has stopped being a buffer
a lane closure is mostly road
The same closure, to scale along its length (1 px = 5 ft)
